deprecationInfo.message: Renamed to "Internet connectivity". The new key is %internetSettings_webView_title_3%.
Relabeled to "Registration information". The new key is %mainMenu_openParatextRegistration_2%.
Renamed to "Registration information". The new key is %paratextRegistrationProfile_webView_title_2%.
Renamed to "Internet connectivity settings updated". The new key is %paratextRegistration_alert_updatedInternetSettings_3%.
Shortened label to "Unrestricted". The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_Enabled_2%.
Changed label to "Disable ALL internet access". The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_Disabled_2%.
Removed the "Disable all Internet access" option. Disabled is now labeled with %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_VpnRequired_2%.
Removed the "Disable all Internet access" option. Disabled is now described by %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_DisableSomeServices_details%.
"Send/Receive" is now called "sync". The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_Enabled_details_2%.
Changed label to "Disable access to some Bible translation services". The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_VpnRequired_2%.
"Send/Receive" is now called "sync". The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_VpnRequired_details_2%.

Now says Paratext may still connect to other internet services, and that this option will change to "Disable all Internet access" once that is available. The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_DisableSomeServices_details%.
Relabeled to "Development server" so the developer-only picker names what it selects. The new key is %paratextRegistration_label_serverType_option_Development_2%.
Relabeled to "Production server" so the developer-only picker names what it selects. The new key is %paratextRegistration_label_serverType_option_Production_2%.
Relabeled to "Quality assurance server" so the developer-only picker names what it selects. The new key is %paratextRegistration_label_serverType_option_QualityAssurance_2%.
Relabeled to "Test server" so the developer-only picker names what it selects. The new key is %paratextRegistration_label_serverType_option_Test_2%.

The invalid registration warning became an alert with both a title and subtitle instead of just a one-line warning. The replacement keys are %paratextRegistration_alert_invalidRegistration% and %paratextRegistration_alert_invalidRegistration_description%.
The registration in Paratext 10 is no longer shared with Paratext 9
Changed the value of this locale to just be "Paratext Registration". The new key is %paratextRegistration_webView_title_2%.
Removed when the paratextRegistration.shouldShowOnStartup setting was removed.
Removed when the paratextRegistration.shouldShowOnStartup setting was removed.
Removed when the paratextRegistration.shouldShowOnStartup setting was removed.
Removed when the paratextRegistration.shouldShowOnStartup setting was removed.
Changed the title to "Internet & connectivity". The new key is %internetSettings_webView_title_2%.
Changed label to "Configure proxy". The new key is %paratextRegistration_description_internetUse_option_ProxyOnly_2%.
Changed label to "Internet & connectivity settings updated". The new key is %paratextRegistration_alert_updatedInternetSettings_2%.
Updated menu label to match the panel's new name. The new key is %mainMenu_openInternetSettings_2%.

Said these settings are shared with a co-installed Paratext 9. They are not: Platform.Bible keeps its own ParatextData settings directory, so changing them here never reaches Paratext 9. The new key is %internetSettings_webView_subtitle_2%.
Said "Coming soon", which promises a delivery date nobody has set. The badge now says the option is not yet available. The new key is %paratextRegistration_internetUse_notYetAvailable%.

Removed. The per-row "Coming soon" badge (%paratextRegistration_internetUse_comingSoon%) already marks the unavailable options, and dropping the line keeps the first-run wizard's Next button in view. No replacement key.

%paratextRegistration_internetUse_notYet.notes: Short badge on an internet-access option that is shown in the list but does not work yet. The user cannot turn it on. "Available" means "can be used", not "in stock" or "not busy". Keep it short: it sits beside the option's label.

deprecationInfo.message: The title now names the unsupported option. The new key is %paratextRegistration_internetUse_unsupportedSelection_title_2%.
Now also suggests that users stop using Paratext 10 until the option is supported. The new key is %paratextRegistration_internetUse_unsupportedSelection_description_2%.

en.%internetSettings_webView_subtitle%: Manage how Paratext accesses the internet. These settings only apply to the Paratext app (not all internet traffic on your computer), and are shared with any co-installed Paratext 9.
en.%internetSettings_webView_subtitle_2%: Manage how Paratext accesses the internet. These settings apply only to Paratext 10 — not to all internet traffic on your computer, and not to a co-installed Paratext 9.
en.%internetSettings_webView_tooltip%: Enter your Paratext Registration Internet Settings into this form.
en.%paratextRegistration_alert_invalidRegis: Check to make sure that the registration name and code you received are accurately entered here.
en.%paratextRegistration_alert_unchangedReg: Registration name and code have not been changed.
en.%paratextRegistration_alert_updatedRegis: Changes applied! The application will restart in a few seconds.
The application successfully restarted! Your changes are now in effect.
en.%paratextRegistration_alert_validRegistr: You can now save the changes and the app will restart to make them in effect.
en.%paratextRegistration_app_startup_descri: Welcome to {%product_name%}! To get started, login with your registration information.
en.%paratextRegistration_description_intern: These Internet settings only affect connection to Paratext services like the Registry, send/receive, and download resources.
Block internet when in sensitive locations
Automatically blocks Paratext internet access in configured sensitive areas.

Disables access to Registry, Send-Receive (sync), and the Digital Bible Library within Paratext 10. Paratext may connect to other internet services! This option will automatically change to “Disable all Internet access” once available.
Blocks all internet access within the Paratext app. Other applications on your computer are not affected.
Allows Paratext to use the internet for all services: Registry, Send/Receive, and resource downloads.
Allows Paratext to use the internet for all services: Registry, sync, and resource downloads.
Routes Paratext internet traffic through a configured proxy server.
Disable Internet use in sensitive locations
Disable access to some Bible translation services
Disables access to Registry, Send/Receive, and the Digital Bible Library within the Paratext app. Other internet features and other applications are not affected.
Disables access to Registry, sync, and the Digital Bible Library within the Paratext app. Other internet features and other applications are not affected.
en.%paratextRegistration_description_shared: These settings also apply to Paratext 9.
en.%paratextRegistration_exception_register: You must provide a valid Paratext registration before opening resources from the Digital Bible Library.
en.%paratextRegistration_internetUse_footer: Disabled options are planned for future updates.
en.%paratextRegistration_internetUse_unsupp: Your Paratext internet settings have “{selectedOption}” selected. This version of Paratext does not support that option yet, so choose one of the available options to continue.
Choose one of the available options to continue or stop using Paratext 10 until it is supported.
This internet setting is not supported yet
en.%paratextRegistration_registration_detai: If you can't find your registration email, [__visit Paratext Registry__]({registryLink}) to generate a new code, or ask your Paratext support person for help.
en.%paratextRegistration_section_internetSe: These Internet settings only apply to some operations, not to the whole application
en.%paratextRegistration_warning_invalid_em: Please enter a valid email address.
en.%paratextRegistration_warning_invalid_re: This registration code is not correct for this user.

en.%paratextRegistration_webView_tooltip%: Enter your Paratext Registration Information into this form.
en.%paratextRegistrationProfile_webView_too: Adjust your Paratext Registration Account Information here.
en.%settings_paratextRegistration_registrat: Settings related to the user's Paratext Registry connection and some Internet access controls
en.%settings_paratextRegistration_shouldSho: Whether to show the form to enter Paratext Registration information when the application starts if it has not been entered previously

es.%paratextRegistration_alert_invalidRegis: Verifique que el nombre y el código de registro que recibió estén ingresados correctamente aquí.
es.%paratextRegistration_alert_unchangedReg: El nombre y el código de registro no han sido modificados.

Bloquea automáticamente el acceso a internet de Paratext en áreas sensibles configuradas.

Deshabilita el acceso al Registro, Enviar/Recibir (sincronización) y la Biblioteca Bíblica Digital dentro de Paratext 10. ¡Paratext puede conectarse a otros servicios de internet! Esta opción cambiará automáticamente a “Deshabilitar todo el acceso a Internet” cuando esté disponible.
Deshabilitar todo el acceso a Internet
Bloquea todo el acceso a internet dentro de la aplicación Paratext. Otras aplicaciones en tu computadora no se ven afectadas.
Permitir uso de Internet sin restricción
Permite a Paratext usar internet para todos los servicios: Registro, Enviar/Recibir y descargas de recursos.
Permite a Paratext usar internet para todos los servicios: Registro, sincronización y descargas de recursos.
Enruta el tráfico de internet de Paratext a través de un servidor proxy configurado.
Deshabilitar acceso a algunos servicios de traducción bíblica
Deshabilita el acceso al Registro, Enviar/Recibir y la Biblioteca Bíblica Digital dentro de la aplicación Paratext. Otras funciones de internet y otras aplicaciones no se ven afectadas.
Deshabilita el acceso al Registro, la sincronización y la Biblioteca Bíblica Digital dentro de la aplicación Paratext. Otras funciones de internet y otras aplicaciones no se ven afectadas.
